name: Rasputin
source:
"I understand... a human chair again... Hehe... Oww."

Based on Grigori Yefimovich Rasputin, who was a Russian peasant, mystical faith healer and a trusted friend to the Tsar's family. He became an influential figure in Saint Petersburg, especially after August 1915 when Tsar Nicholas II took command of the army at the front.

A super masochistic Russian hero who lives for the punishment meted out by [url=/c5153]Ivan the Terrible[/url]. Rasputin is capable of turning any kind of physical and mental pain into pleasure.

She often deliberately fails her missions so that she can get punished by Ivan. She even rejoices in the punishment where Ivan neglects the punishment and ignores her. Invincible in some ways.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char14b]English official site[/url]]
